# Oracle

Source: [`Kernel/Oracle.wl`](../../Kernel/Oracle.wl) · Design notes: [MODULES.md](../MODULES.md#oracle-kerneloraclewl--runoracle)

RunOracle: a numerical cross-check of the assembled equations (DE4plus\_fast.wl section 6c, generalised). At one random point it builds Gamma2 + R numerically, inverts it as a matrix, integrates the loop trace over w with NIntegrate and takes the frequency and momentum projections by finite differences in nu and in an explicit d-vector p, in d = 2 and 3. It is independent of Propagator, Projection, FrequencyIntegration and Assemble; it shares the vertices and the loop formula, so it does not test the loop normalisation (E3/E4). Objective, assumptions and checks: docs/MODULES.md section "Oracle".

## Symbols

### `RunOracle`

`RunOracle[equations, opts]` compares every equation (and, with "ZeroFlows" -> True, every flow that must vanish) with a numerical evaluation of the loop at one random point: numeric matrix inverse, NIntegrate over w, finite differences in nu and p. Options: "Dimensions" -> Automatic ({2, 3} for a symbolic d, {2} for a declared d = 2), "Tolerance" -> 10^-8 (relative; absolute for zero flows), "Seed" -> 1, "ZeroFlows" -> False. Returns the "Oracle" stage.
